text:
When a molecule rebounds from a wall, a force is exerted on the wall.
What causes this force?
A
the kinetic energy gained by the molecule
B
the kinetic energy lost by the molecule
C
the change of momentum of the molecule
D
the change of speed of the molecule

options.label: A
options.text: the kinetic energy gained by the molecule

options.label: B
options.text: the kinetic energy lost by the molecule

options.label: C
options.text: the change of momentum of the molecule

options.label: D
options.text: the change of speed of the molecule
